card.name: Dark Jeroid
card.effect: If this card is Summoned: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it loses 800 ATK.

behavior: Accepts a genuine post-summon event for Normal, Flip or Special Summon; the source must be face-up on the current controller team's shared field.
The active physical representative of the source controller team selects one face-up monster on either team, including Dark Jeroid itself.
The selected monster receives a persistent -800 ATK adjustment; DEF is unchanged and the engine's atk() result is floored at zero.
A TargetBinding zone epoch prevents applying the old activation to a different incarnation after the target leaves and returns.
Changing control without leaving the Monster Zone does not invalidate the selected physical card.
The effect resolves if Dark Jeroid leaves the field after activation; negation and duplicate/replayed activations are idempotent.
Physical UIDs, owners, private hands and Deck/Extra Deck inventories are conserved.

covers: active-seat target selection and physical owner/control separation
invalid, negated, face-down, stale and forged summon events
target removed, turned face-down, returned with a new lifetime epoch, or merely changes controller
effect negation, duplicate receipts and JSON restoration
ATK floor at zero with DEF unchanged
hand above six remains untouched until End Phase
Deck 20 and 30, Extra Deck 5, and 3+3 zone limits

integrationBoundary: Isolated adapter only. Dark Jeroid is not yet in the engine-v9 certificate set, so focused tests inject an already-admitted effect-monster fixture ID. The production passcode remains 90980792. Central summon-trigger wiring, catalog admission, certification and Discord command integration remain blocked pending explicit M61 handoff.
limitations: The host must emit a genuine successful summon event and pass the selected target UID from the active controller seat.
No real Discord gateway/guild session or production database was used.
No central resolver, card metadata, certification, release allowlist, persistent player data or production files were changed.
